facts.fact: SOS Médias Burundi reports that Merankabandi, a joint programme of the Government of Burundi, the World Bank and WFP, paid selected refugees in Ruyigi (Buhumuza) 73,600 BIF every two months to their mobile phones for two years, to nearly 8,000 households in five camps, ending in September 2025.

systems.owner: Government of Burundi with World Bank and WFP
